sentence: This project studies how targeting the bromodomain of a chromatin remodeling complex changes stemness and treatment sensitivity in glioblastoma cells.
This project tests whether gene therapy can safely treat male infertility caused by Sertoli cell dysfunction.
This project makes polyclonal and monoclonal antibodies that bind a target glycan and tests how well they bind.
This project builds an ultrasound imaging technology that finds coronary atherosclerotic plaques that are likely to rupture.
This project studies how a nonstructural protein of respiratory syncytial virus changes the way the host responds to infection.
This project continues a partnership that does research and gives technical help to lower the risk of foodborne microbial contamination of produce.
This project studies how microRNAs control the work of airway smooth muscle cells in asthma.
This project tries to find out how an ion channel controls the excitability of myoepithelial cells and milk ejection during lactation.
This project tests how alcohol causes tolerance by inhibiting presynaptic active zone proteins in Drosophila.
This project tries to find out how white blood cells cause inflammation in asthma and sinus disease.
This project studies how enzymes and lipid transport proteins work in lipid metabolism and transport.
This project builds a system using artificial intelligence that learns single-cell optical image features of diffuse gliomas.
This project studies how DNA sequence variants in the protocadherin gene cluster change the way neural circuits form during development.
This project studies how a totipotency pathway helps adult cells become induced pluripotent stem cells during reprogramming.
This project tests and improves gene tools that change many genes at once, for use in cancer and immunology research.
This project builds a data management system and tests risk scores for white matter lesions seen on MRI.
This project tests a drill that makes cavities in the intervertebral disc and compares it with the usual lumbar interbody fusion technique in pigs.
This project studies how anti-amyloid immunotherapies for Alzheimer's disease cause changes in brain blood vessels and tries to prevent them.
